title: PLAYER 2 EARNS THE KILL TROPHIES
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: GOLD HUNTER and OVERSEER DOWN are given by trophyKill when a body falls, but on the player 2 window his own kill arrives as the host's kill word (netKillTake), which never called trophyKill, so player 2 could never earn either plaque. Proven in headless Chromium: player 2 killing the Overseer and the golden enemy left {"p2Trophies":"{}"} while the same two bodies gave the host "overseer,golden". The kill word now calls trophyKill on the body, which already knows the Overseer mirror by its name and the golden enemy by the host's gilding.
now: Player 2 now earns GOLD HUNTER and OVERSEER DOWN for his own kills.
